super6.race: Coral Racing Club Intermediate Handicap Hurdle (Reg' As The Gerry Feilden) (Premier Handicap) (GBB Race)
super6.comment: Enjoyed a fine campaign last season, recording her fourth win in 22-runner Dawn Run Mares' Novices' Hurdle at Cheltenham. Undone by a falsely-run race on drying ground at Haydock (21f) the following month and shaped well for a long way in 2½m handicap at Sandown on return. Not taken lightly.

Runner-up both starts in France for Marcel Rolland. Created a good impression when going one better in 2m maiden here on stable debut in February and not disgraced with sixth of 9 in Percy Maynard Juvenile here in April. More is needed at these weights though back in handicap company.

super6.race: Pennine Flooring On The Radio Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
super6.comment: Successful first 2 starts in novice hurdles, including at this course. Without a win sent chasing last season, but showed promise when runner-up in handicap over C&D (heavy) on second outing. Pulled up on good ground at Haydock when last seen in April, though.

super6.race: AWC Finals Day At Newcastle 26th March Nursery
super6.comment: Persian Force colt who boasts a progressive profile, scoring back-to-back over 6f on turf in August. Stepped up further in defeat since, settling better ridden with more restraint when keeping on for second at Kempton (6f) 31 days ago. Raised 4 lb but fancied to be very competitive again.

super6.race: Make The Move To Midnite Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
super6.comment: Borderline useful mare who has been coming up short in listed company this year. Now 8 lb higher than her latest start in a handicap last summer and looks up against it on these terms.

finals.race: J&D Pierce Steeling The Race Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
finals.comment: Rattled off a quick-fire 5-timer in May/June and back on the up with wins in the Durham National at Sedgefield (29f) and 8-runner handicap chase at Carlisle (3¼m, good) recently. Up another 4 lb but not taken lightly in his current mood.

finals.race: Play Coral 'Racing-Super-Series' Mares' Novices' Hurdle (Listed) (GBB Race)
finals.comment: Justified favouritism in an Irish point and plenty of positives to draw from a pair of placed efforts in bumpers last season, third in Grade 2 company at Aintree. Hammered a subsequent winner at Ffos Las (2½m) on hurdling debut/reappearance and rates an exciting prospect for in-form yard.

finals.race: Howard Evans Roofing & Cladding Mares' Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
finals.comment: Expensive pointer who set the clear standard on her hurdles form last season and made no mistake on reappearance in maiden company against her own sex at Stratford a month ago. Promises to excel over fences so she's a very interesting contender.

finals.race: Coral Sir Peter O'Sullevan Memorial Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
finals.comment: Opened his account over fences over shorter here last winter and essentially shaped well in defeat thereafter (badly hampered in the Ultima), including when second at Aintree on return. Remains of interest.

finals.race: Dranfields CIU National Charity Raceday Mares' Novices' Hurdle (GBB Race)
finals.comment: Lightly-raced mare out of useful type for same connections. Proved a different proposition when successful in 4-runner novice on return at Huntingdon (2½m), jumping/travelling well before quickening clear. Sets a fair standard under a penalty and will go on improving.

finals.race: SES Engineering Powering Past The Rehearsal Handicap Chase (Premier Handicap) (GBB Race)
finals.comment: Advanced his form sent chasing last season, off the mark at the fifth attempt in maiden at Carlisle. Failed to see out marathon trip at Cheltenham Festival but resumed winning ways in good style dropped back in trip at Bangor on return and remains one to be positive about.

finals.race: Bowmer And Kirkland We Build As One Fighting Fifth Hurdle (Grade 1) (GBB Race)
finals.comment: Highly progressive when landing the Greatwood Hurdle/Kingwell last season. Didn't look out of place in Grade 1 company subsequently, finishing a place ahead of Golden Ace at both Cheltenham and Aintree. The one to beat following a decisive Grade 2 success on return at Aintree earlier this month.

finals.race: Close Brothers Rated Novice Hurdle
finals.comment: Jet Away gelding who made a successful hurdling debut at Wexford in October by 20 lengths. Open to improvement but likely to find this a bit too competitive.

finals.race: Coral Racing Club Intermediate Handicap Hurdle (Reg' As The Gerry Feilden) (Premier Handicap) (GBB Race)
finals.comment: Enjoyed a fine campaign last season, recording her fourth win in 22-runner Dawn Run Mares' Novices' Hurdle at Cheltenham. Undone by a falsely-run race on drying ground at Haydock (21f) the following month and shaped well for a long way in 2½m handicap at Sandown on return. Not taken lightly.

finals.race: Francis McGee Memorial Handicap Hurdle
finals.comment: Runner-up both starts in France for Marcel Rolland. Created a good impression when going one better in 2m maiden here on stable debut in February and not disgraced with sixth of 9 in Percy Maynard Juvenile here in April. More is needed at these weights though back in handicap company.

finals.race: Jodie Standing's Point-To-Point Recruits Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
finals.comment: Fair veteran with form figures of 212 over fences at this track (victory in 2024 renewal of this race). Back on his latest winning mark when no match for a less-exposed sort late on at Sedgefield (21f) last time. Probably vulnerable in a deeper race for the grade here.

finals.race: Pennine Flooring On The Radio Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
finals.comment: Successful first 2 starts in novice hurdles, including at this course. Without a win sent chasing last season, but showed promise when runner-up in handicap over C&D (heavy) on second outing. Pulled up on good ground at Haydock when last seen in April, though.

finals.race: Coral 'Pipped-At-The-Post' And Win Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
finals.comment: In fine form switched to fences initially last season and completed a hat-trick at Warwick in January. However, below par in his 3 subsequent runs, including when fell last in handicap at Ascot (17f, good to firm) on his return.

finals.race: All-Weather Championship Is Back Nursery
finals.comment: Took a step forward to get off the mark in 8-runner nursery at Lingfield (7f) 9 days ago, going clear final 100 yds and closed down only late on by Bacha. Limit may not yet have been reached.

finals.race: All-Weather Championship Is Back Nursery
finals.comment: Made a winning start in 5f Southwell maiden in April and similar form when third under a penalty at Kempton (6f). However, hasn't offered much encouragement in 3 runs since, including in first-time cheekpieces at Chelmsford latest.

finals.race: All-Weather Championship Is Back Nursery
finals.comment: Showed promise in minor events/maiden for the Fahey yard and duly showed improved form for the step up in trip when 1½ lengths second of 8 to Arthur Carrot on nursery/stable debut at Lingfield (7f) 9 days ago, finishing well. Remains unexposed and of interest again.

finals.race: Midnite A Next Generation Betting App Handicap (Div 1)
finals.comment: Ended 2025 on a high, recording back-to-back wins at Newcastle in November. Posted a good second in hat-trick bid at Wolverhampton but form went the wrong way after. First run for yard after leaving Ivan Furtado and market check advised.

finals.race: AWC Season 14 Has Begun EBF Fillies' Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
finals.comment: Starspangledbanner filly who produced a promising first effort when finishing a length second of 6 in a Wolverhampton maiden (7f) 32 days ago, taking that place final 100 yds. In very good hands and she's a likely player with improvement forthcoming.

finals.race: AWC Finals Day At Newcastle 26th March Nursery
finals.comment: Oasis Dream colt who has displayed race-by-race progress in a trio of C&D novice events this autumn, not entirely professional under pressure but making use of experience edge over a debutant when landing 13-runner contest 3 weeks ago. Opening mark looks lenient and big shout on nursery debut.

finals.race: AWC Finals Day At Newcastle 26th March Nursery
finals.comment: Persian Force colt who boasts a progressive profile, scoring back-to-back over 6f on turf in August. Stepped up further in defeat since, settling better ridden with more restraint when keeping on for second at Kempton (6f) 31 days ago. Raised 4 lb but fancied to be very competitive again.

finals.race: AWC Finals Day At Newcastle 26th March Nursery
finals.comment: In the frame on first 4 starts and made most of a good opportunity under a forceful ride when opening his account in a C&D novice in October. Runner-up has boosted the form since but an opening mark of 76 does demand that bit more on stable debut (changed hands for 25,000 gns).

finals.race: AWC Finals Day At Newcastle 26th March Nursery
finals.comment: Showed ability in a trio of novice events during the summer. Off 4 months/gelded, his opening mark looked a stiff one when sixth of 8 on nursery debut at Lingfield (7f) 9 days ago. Eased 3 lb but others look much stronger here.

finals.race: Midnite: Built For 2027 Not 2007 Handicap
finals.comment: Three-time C&D winner who ended 2025 in fine form, rattling off a quick-fire hat-trick at Wolverhampton in December. Hasn't fired in a truncated 2026 campaign but his mark is steadily easing and best not judged too harshly on his latest run (caught wide). Still, he looks best watched.

finals.race: Make The Move To Midnite Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
finals.comment: Borderline useful mare who has been coming up short in listed company this year. Now 8 lb higher than her latest start in a handicap last summer and looks up against it on these terms.

finals.race: Make The Move To Midnite Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
finals.comment: Multiple all-weather winner. Slipped below his latest winning mark having been well beaten (at long odds) over a much shorter trip at Kempton (1m) on second start back from a break. Difficult to assess and market can guide with Jack Callan replacing inexperienced rider.
